short_description.html:
Dolce Vita is an Italian brand that has made a series of hot drinks for Nespresso® in different flavors, such as this delicious Creme Brulee variant. The Dolce Vita drinks are created in café style, and are a good alternative to a cup of coffee if you want to save on caffeine, or for the youngest who are not quite ready for a full coffee yet.

Dolce Vita Creme Brulee is inspired by the classic French dessert. The taste is as it is known in a Creme Brulee vanilla-like, with a toasted caramelized body and a creamy consistency.

Dolce Vita has been innovative here and created a variant you do not see every day for Nespresso®. A Nespresso® machine is not just for coffee, and here you get a new and unique taste experience, which is perfect for self-pampering when you need a little break.

Dolce Vita Creme Brulee is brewed perfectly in your Nespresso® machine, but remember to have it brewed with the espresso button on your machine, so you get the best result.

This product has no affilitation with nor is it produced by or recognised by Nestlé®.

A balanced herbal tea for the colder months

  • 17 tea bags
  • Caffeine-free
  • Herbaceous, fruity and citrusy flavour with a gentle tartness
  • With acerola cherry, rose hip, basil, elderberry and lemon

Yogi Tea Immune Support brings together acerola cherry, rose hip, basil and elderberry with bright notes of lemon, lemon verbena and lemongrass, in a herbal blend with a herbaceous, fruity and citrusy profile. Each pack contains 17 teabags, making it easy to prepare a cup whenever it suits your day.

Enjoy the warm, fruity notes of Yogi Tea Immune Support today!
